title: MVP2 · Grasp, hold and transport
purpose: Collect real gripper/object evidence to compare grasp, slip, lift and transport, and identify contact parameters only where measurements support them.

guided.default_scope_notice: Collection specification only. No grasp fitting, Newton screening, robot motion or transfer validation has run.

minimum_kit: Robot/controller logger and gripper command + measured opening logger
Fixed video view of peg relative to fingers, with timestamps/synchronization event and visible scale or calibrated reference
Scale, appropriate dimensional gauges and a safe catch/support fixture
Qualified wrist force/torque is recommended for contact/load diagnosis; independent jaw-force evidence is needed for friction identification
pilot: First record one operator-approved grasp-hold-replace trial. Check command/feedback freshness, visibility, clocks and gripper width before repeating anything.

parameters.evidence: Measured peg dimensions, mass and material; photos and tool-to-peg transform
parameters.limit: Do not fit mass from a binary lift result. CAD-derived COM/inertia are priors with uncertainty, not measurements.

parameters.evidence: Actual width/effort commands after driver processing, measured jaw gap and independent squeeze force if available
parameters.limit: MVP1 should qualify free-motion response. A force command/current is not measured jaw normal force.

parameters.evidence: Known jaw normal force, independent tangential load and synchronized relative slip
parameters.limit: Without independent normal force, record holding/slip behavior only; do not claim an identified friction coefficient. Wrist F/T cannot measure opposing jaw squeeze.

parameters.evidence: Synchronized force and local finger/peg displacement over two approved loading rates
parameters.limit: Separate fixture/finger/controller compliance; quasistatic evidence does not identify damping.

parameters.evidence: Same real trials and a separate simulation sensitivity/convergence study
parameters.limit: No real sensor measures solver iterations. Bind only supported backend fields; freeze runtime settings before physical fitting.

trials.motion: Reference squeeze; lower approved acceleration: close → short lift → hold → transport → replace → release
Second approved squeeze; same lower-acceleration cycle
Reference squeeze; second approved acceleration cycle
Second approved squeeze; second approved acceleration cycle
Supported, guarded slip-onset experiment at approved normal load A
trials.trigger: Independent normal/tangential force available and friction identification requested; no uncontained drops

trials.motion: Supported, guarded slip-onset experiment at approved normal load B
trials.trigger: Same gate as B4; change normal load independently, not friction and load together

trials.motion: Reserved grasp-and-transport condition not used for fitting or model selection

conditional_experiments.when: Sliding friction is in scope and onset trials are insufficient
conditional_experiments.collect: Controlled steady sliding at two approved normal loads; measure tangential force, normal force and relative velocity; reserve an independent sliding holdout
Force versus local deflection on loading/unloading at two approved rates, with independent holdouts; do not infer damping from static images

conditional_experiments.when: Task failures show unresolved twist or rolling
conditional_experiments.collect: Separately approved torque/twist or rolling experiment with load and angular motion measurements; not identifiable from straight lifts alone

required_sections: baseline/tuned held-out comparison when fitting exists
reporting.result_source: Actual run records only; no result values live in this recipe.

limitations: No guarantee all contact parameters can be independently identified.
Video-only slip observations do not determine squeeze force or a unique friction coefficient.
Torsional/rolling friction, restitution and deformable material constants are outside the core collection.
Grasp fitting and package activation are not implemented by this collection recipe.
